book.name: Loum
book.title: Polota Loum sos dla yu ilimale hamili Loum

content: Epedeme mikadepe dle so namkadulo, na꞉tapo na꞉ dupa dulu tle Isalael so yilo sikemte inoma sumale pato himhalemde, yia꞉tapo pasakalo gadle halepo depame.
Isalael so yia꞉ sikemte solotamde God dolumtlowedeme, amasiyama dulu edla yia꞉ ikadepe api tle God dolumtloweye poyia꞉malamana.

Epapedeme yia꞉ mape Godta meyelo opaye ya꞉ mila꞉pi tle ullu pa꞉talo so demhalaye poyia꞉malamana. Amasiyama yia꞉ miyelo itiyamale tle God mila꞉pi tle ullu pa꞉talo so dlowa depo yia꞉ aiyalma dolumha꞉ha꞉ta yia꞉ pogadesema. Epapele koko tle yia꞉tapo ikadepe God mila꞉pi tle ullu pa꞉talo so depo ha꞉ha꞉lowe koko haloweye posolotamasema.

Adipalati, Kelisotapo aiyalmata halopo puwa koko hapulomaye dia꞉ yilo ma-ala꞉po guduwapo. Epapedeme oplami antapo Keliso dla mikadepe dlepiye, asiyama Godtapo ya꞉ye ya꞉ mila꞉pi tle ullu pa꞉le oplami dlepe.
Ka꞉dle yutapo pasakalo gadle kokoye hampuwapo
Epapedeme aiyalmata hampuale ullu pa꞉po hallowe koko dla Mosestapo epo atluwapo, “Oplami antapo me-pasakalo hali dlepiye, ya꞉ aiyalma koko hapulomaye woloma dolumhallepe,” duwapo.
Amasiyama mikadepe dle kokota hampuale ullu pa꞉po hallowe kokotapo epo atlapo, “Poka꞉dena, opatapo Kelisota yia꞉ gadlepo depame Pepele dimo dla Keliso totamala hetloweye.
Epame ma poka꞉dena, opatapo Kelisota yia꞉ gadlepo depame tame wabasi dulu dla ya꞉ totamsiyamoloweye,” depo.
Adipalati, isikimi hatlo Keliso dla mikadepe dlowe koko siyapota pasakalo gadlowe kokoye hampumhalapo. Adipalati, God yu bukata epo atlapo,

content.text: “God ya꞉ yuye wa꞉ mateka꞉pi dla halapo.
Epame yu eye wa꞉ mati dla epo wa꞉ dupa dulu dla elapo.”

content: Epedeme mikadepe depo hallowe yu eye dita atlamsiyamapo.
Epedeme wa꞉ wa꞉ mati tle Yesuye Lodpo depo botomastapame ma ya꞉ye Godta ma powale tle ma pasakalo dle koko dla mikadepe dlepiye, wa꞉ye pasakalo gadle halepe.

Adipalati, wa꞉ dupa duluta mikadepe dle koko tle Godta wa꞉ye ya꞉ mila꞉pi tle ullu pa꞉le oplami demhalapo. Epame wa꞉ mati tle Yesuye Lodpo depo botomastlepiye, etapo wa꞉ye pasakalo gadle kokoye halepe.
Adipalati, God yu bukatapo epo atlapo,

content.text: “Oplami antapo Keliso dla mikadepe dlepiye, ya꞉ wota꞉le ponatimhallowa,” depo.

content: Ipapele koko dulu dla di natipo, Yu so mate epo po-Yu so mateye ma-hatlopepo. Adipalati, di Lod ma hatlopepo. Epapele koko tle ya꞉tapo ya꞉ watle otele himha꞉ha꞉ so dla ka꞉ka꞉dle koko hapuloma halopimhalapo.
Adipalati, God yu bukatapo epo atlapo,

content.text: “Oplami antapo gadle yilo Lod dla otele himhallepiye,

content: Epapele dulu dla opata God dla pomikadepe dlalo wekematiye, yia꞉ adipammama pasakalo gadlowe yilo ya꞉ dla otele himpa꞉? Epame yia꞉tapo ya꞉ koko podlallalo wekematiye, yia꞉ adipammama ya꞉ dla mikadepe depa꞉? Epame ka꞉dle yuye yia꞉ dla po-atlamalalo wekematiye, yia꞉ adipammama God yu dalepo hapa꞉?
Epame ka꞉dle yu atlamalalo soye potaiya dlalo wekematiye, yia꞉ adipo God yu atlamsiyamelemo? Epapedeme God yu bukatapo epo atlapo,

content.text: “Ka꞉dle yu hamsiyamalalo sotapo ka꞉dle yu hame pula natiloweye pta ka꞉pi.”

content: Amasiyama dulu edla pase opa hapulomatapo pomikadepe dena. Yu iye Aisayatapo God yu buka dla epo atluwapo,

content.text: “Lod, di yuye opa anawolota mikadepe duwa?”

content: Epapedeme ka꞉dle yu Yesu Keliso koko dallowe kokotapo mikadepe dlowe kokoye hampuapo.
Epapele dulu dla Isalael soye adipapopa꞉? Yia꞉ ka꞉dle yu mo-daluwa? Yao, yia꞉ ma-dlaluwapo. Adipalati, God yu bukata epo atlapo,

content.text: “Ka꞉dle yu hamsiyamalalo sotapo ka꞉dle yuye ta꞉lamo pato dla tame

content: Amasiyama Isalael sotapo ka꞉dle yu iye dalepame malamale hauwa? Yao, yia꞉ malamale hauwa tlope, woloma pomikadepe dena. Epedeme Mosestapo epo ilimuwapo,

content.text: ma wua꞉tapo yia꞉ dla elle himha꞉ha꞉mama yia꞉ dla siyalasiyalademha꞉ha꞉lepe.’”

content: Epame Aisayatapo Godta atlamale yu iye wota꞉le pa꞉po epo atluwapo,

content.text: “Opa na꞉ pototamha꞉ha꞉lalo wekele sotapo na꞉ye ma-natiwapo.
Epame na꞉tapo na꞉ pototamalalo wekele so dla naskamu na꞉ kokoye nati-iwapo.”

content: Amasiyama Godtapo Isalael so dla epo atluwapo,

content.text: “Na꞉ alila hapuloma dulu dla wua꞉ elemolowedeme ma-dinapopo halemduwapo.
Amasiyama muwolo dupa kokalalimale koko tle na꞉ yu dla dalepo salladla allimduwapo.”
